notes: REF-BM-02: title/description/preview image captured, but favicon is never collected or stored. REF-BM-03: auto-collected title/description editable only after saving (Edit details); capture persists immediately with no pre-save review of the fetched metadata. REF-BM-04: edits title/description (and tags via a separate dialog) but the url cannot be edited and there is no note field. REF-BM-07: cards show title/description/tags/preview image but no favicon (a letter mark is used instead). REF-BM-08: selecting an item opens an internal saved-copy reader, not the original url; the original is only a secondary 'Try original page' link. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/host only — no note (field absent) and no full url path. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax; tag filtering is a separate chip mechanism. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT/parenthesised boolean query support. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no bulk action across the filtered collection. REF-BM-23: no note field or markdown rendering. REF-BM-24: self-contained HTML snapshot works, but PDF urls are rejected ('did not return a readable webpage') rather than downloaded/stored. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive snapshot support. REF-BM-29: saved views persist search term + a single included tag + sort, but no excluded tags and no multiple included tags. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no Netscape HTML export. REF-BM-32: no display settings (items-per-page fixed at 8, no font size, sort not persisted).
